description: Helps you decide whether to scale paid now: it takes your customer list (signing date, segment, monthly fee and any stop or return dates) and your churn reasons, and returns, for each customer group, scale, run a capped test, or hold, with the counts behind it, the stop rule, payback, a first draft response to each churn reason and a churn interview guide.

as_of.description: The date the list was pulled (YYYY-MM-DD)

blended_cac.description: Optional: blended CAC, shown for contrast only

business_model.description: Business model, passed on to retention_playbook

churn_reasons.description: Reasons in customers' words, comma or line separated

customers.description: One row per customer (1 to 2000 items)

monthly_fee.description: Monthly fee at signing (annual contracts: the yearly fee divided by 12)

monthly_starts.description: Optional: activity in each of the 12 months before as_of (or before stopped), for the seasonal tag

resumed.description: Optional: date they paid again, if they came back (YYYY-MM-DD)

stopped.description: Optional: the first date a payment was due and not paid (for annual contracts, the renewal date they did not renew), YYYY-MM-DD

gross_margin.description: Optional (0 to 1): gross margin needed for the money section

interview_persona.description: Role to interview, for the interview kit

metrics.description: Optional: each metric with its name, value, whether it counts customers or revenue, and its period

counts.description: Optional: whether the metric counts customers or revenue

period.description: Optional: period over which the metric is measured

payback_line_months.description: Optional (default 12): the longest acceptable paid payback in months. 12 is Shashwat's example line for a $36,000 contract, not a benchmark.

stop_line.description: Optional (default 0.80): share of a cohort that must still pay at month 12. 0.80 is Shashwat's example line for a $36,000 contract, not a benchmark.

test_cap.description: Optional: all-in budget for a capped test

win_rate_floor.description: Optional (0 to 1): a win rate the buyer is confident paid can reach

win_rate_target.description: Optional (0 to 1): the highest win rate the buyer would believe

name: scale_paid_check
title: Scale Paid Check
